snippet.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Coaches Video Trailer
snippet.description:
Passengers, please take your seats, your journey is almost ready to begin! We are excited to reveal the official video trailer and release date for the Coaches DLC for Euro Truck Simulator 2. 

Trade cargo for passengers in a whole new ETS2 journey! Take a seat behind the wheel, not of a truck, but of a coach. The Coaches DLC brings a new dimension to the ETS2 experience by introducing scheduled passenger transport across Europe.

Add the Coaches DLC to your Steam Wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3809270/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2_Coaches/
